instructions: Run after an owner-approved production deployment in a fresh browser profile. Record the deployed Git revision and Netlify deploy ID before testing. Stop rollout or restore the prior published deploy when a blocking expectation fails.

tests.name: Homepage
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Homepage navigation, two restrained Advertisements placeholders, no live ad creative, and no horizontal overflow.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for missing content, wrong canonical, live ads, or broken layout; otherwise investigate CDN/header propagation before accepting the deploy.

tests.name: Robots
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Allows public crawling and names https://www.ilovetimers.com/sitemap.xml without blocking JavaScript, CSS, tools, or guides.
tests.failureAction: Treat an incorrect origin or broad disallow as blocking and rollback or correct the published static file.

tests.name: XML sitemap
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Valid XML with 109 unique production-origin indexable canonical URLs and no aliases, noindex routes, or query strings.
tests.failureAction: Treat a stale, malformed, or development-origin sitemap as blocking.

tests.name: Indexable timer
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Stopped countdown with labeled inputs; Apply, Start, Reset, Share setup, and preset controls work without console errors.
tests.failureAction: Rollback if the tool cannot start/pause/reset or metadata is wrong.

tests.name: Noindex utility
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Ready one-minute countdown starts only after activation and remains absent from the XML sitemap.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for missing noindex, wrong canonical, or broken timer behavior.

tests.name: Redirect alias
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: One direct permanent redirect to /online-timer with no intermediate hop.
tests.failureAction: Treat a chain, loop, temporary redirect, or alias-rendered page as blocking.

tests.name: Guide
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Published guide content, visible sources, guide navigation, and valid Article/Breadcrumb structured data.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for missing article content, invalid metadata, or broken high-value sources.

tests.name: Calculator
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Labeled inputs accept valid and invalid values, result updates correctly, and assumptions remain visible.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for incorrect deterministic results or unusable controls.

tests.name: Timezone tool
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: DST-sensitive conversion controls work, limitations are visible, and no permission prompt occurs.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for incorrect boundary conversion, broken timezone choices, or metadata drift.

tests.name: Share URL
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Loads a stopped 1:01 setup, reports the restored setup, creates no preset, and keeps canonical, Open Graph, and structured-data URLs query-free.
tests.failureAction: Rollback if state autostarts, leaks query metadata, or writes a preset.

tests.name: Preset save and reload
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: A named preset saves locally, reloads, loads, renames, deletes, and clears without entering the URL or another tool's storage.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for data corruption, cross-tool deletion, URL leakage, or a route crash.

tests.name: Privacy page
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Current disclosures cover local storage, presets, share links, coordinates, Sunrise-Sunset API, consent-gated PostHog, and disabled advertising.
tests.failureAction: Treat behavior/disclosure contradiction as blocking and correct before continuing rollout.

tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Branded error page offers a path back without a fatal stack trace.
tests.failureAction: Rollback if the platform converts this to 200, leaks a stack, or renders a blank page.

tests.name: Advertising disabled
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: No request to googlesyndication.com or doubleclick.net; placeholders do not behave as links and no tool route contains one.
tests.failureAction: Disable the unexpected script or rollback immediately.

tests.name: Analytics consent
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Before consent there is no PostHog request. Decline keeps tools working. If a production key is intentionally configured, Allow produces only privacy-limited route/action events and the choice can be changed.
tests.failureAction: Rollback or remove the analytics environment key if capture starts before consent or includes query/input data.

tests.name: Ads.txt
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: Plain-text root response contains exactly the owner-confirmed authorized seller record and no placeholder publisher ID.
tests.failureAction: Do not enable advertising; correct the file only after confirming the intended AdSense publisher ID.

tests.name: Structured data and mobile console
tests.expectedVisibleBehavior: At 390px light and dark, valid JSON-LD uses production canonical URLs, controls do not overlap, and the browser console has no hydration or runtime error.
tests.failureAction: Rollback for invalid schema, query/local URLs, horizontal overflow, clipped primary controls, or runtime errors.
